timeline.labelEn: The Marquis de Sade secretly writes The 120 Days of Sodom while imprisoned in the Bastille
timeline.labelDe: Der Marquis de Sade schreibt in der Bastille heimlich „Die 120 Tage von Sodom“

questions.notes: Full name Donatien Alphonse François, Marquis de Sade (1740–1814). The 37-day figure is the card's; the source confirms he wrote it secretly in the Bastille in 1785.

timeline.labelEn: Carl Linnaeus gives the dromedary its scientific name Camelus dromedarius
timeline.labelDe: Carl von Linné gibt dem Dromedar den wissenschaftlichen Namen Camelus dromedarius

source.title: Why Baby Camels Are Born Without Humps

questions.notes: Card answer: true. Newborn calves have a flattish back with only small tufted peaks where the humps will grow; humps are fat reserves built up later.
